events.label: Sweep best of 6
events.summary: Sweep best of 6: 3.9 ± 1.1 vs 0.0 ± 0.0 for current practice (visits/week by residents who can't make current hours). SW Sweep best of 6 wins because it raises visits/week from residents who cannot make current hours from 0.0 ± 0.0 under current practice to 3.9 ± 1.1, the highest of all options, while using 76 staff h/wk, only 1 h/wk above current practice and below E1’s 85 h/wk. It also holds up best on held-out tests, leading in all three scenarios (3.375, 6.5, 7.0) versus E1/OS (1.875, 4.125, 5.625) and E5 (0.5, 2.25, 3.5).
events.assumptions: The result depends on synthetic resident schedules, arrival patterns, and word-of-mouth rates used by the model defaults; no local source directly constrains those inputs. It also assumes the measured staff h/wk estimates are comparable across proposals.
events.pilot: Run a 6-week pilot with Thursday evening hours only (13:00-21:00) at the library, and compare weekly visits by residents who previously could not attend during current hours against a matched pre-pilot baseline. Measure total visits, unique visitors, and staff hours each week, and note whether demand shifts from daytime to the added evening window.
